extension_reference_resampling: scipy resample_poly 18/25 from 500 Hz to 360 Hz; no waveform cropping or shape based filtering
noise_pool_note: disjoint from original background development/confirmation pools; original gate exploration used full NSTDB, so do not claim its noise is globally unseen
waveform_metrics: quiet P/QRS/T annotated full interval RMSE; annotations used only for evaluation
statistics: equal weight per record; paired record bootstrap 20000 repetitions; descriptive intervals, not confirmatory multiplicity controlled claims
comparison_selection_rule: minimize mean quiet nRMSE subject to mean active nRMSE <= 1.01*best local nRMSE on original development clips; report infeasibility and minimum total normalized MSE fallback

idt_reimplementation.accuracy_note: equation based reimplementation; not verified against MATLAB author code or original tables
